item.title: Claude Code Router (2026): Setup, Providers and Memory
item.description: Claude Code Router (CCR) is a local program that sits between Claude Code and the model provider. Claude Code sends its requests to CCR on your machine. CCR then sends them on to the provider you chose, such as a Claude API key, OpenRouter or DeepSeek. The project is MIT-licensed, on GitHub at musistudio/claude-code-router. Its README says it also works with Codex, OpenCode and other agents, but this page covers only Claude Code.
